layered_book.rationale: Reuse the finite holding/resource-asset P/B screening band; not peer-calibrated, a proven reserve appraisal, or completed SOTP.

operating_book.rationale: Reuse the finite operating-company P/B screen while cash flow, leases, financing and normalization are not fully underwritten; not FCFF.

BC.route_reason: A mine-life SOTP must bridge all ordinary classes and convertible preferred claims.
BC.intrinsic_blocker: Convertible preferred claims and dilution have not been quantified against common equity; a class-specific finite value would be misleading.
BC.source_warning: PSE parent equity is PHP thousands and reported BVPS roughly reconciles to pooled A+B common shares, but convertible preferred remains outstanding. No value or calculator is published until its claim is resolved.

CA.route_reason: Operating assets require normalized FCFF; reported combined common book is only a separate screen.
CA.intrinsic_blocker: Operating cash conversion, maintenance capital needs and the declassification record have not been fully underwritten.
CA.source_warning: PSE PHP11.41 BVPS and the March 2026 equal A/B per-share dividend reconcile to 27,466,449 combined economic common shares. A separately displayed older B stock page is not added again; declassification completion remains under review.

LC.route_reason: Mine-life production and recoverable reserves require SOTP/finite-life DCF; pooled common book is a separate screen.
LC.intrinsic_blocker: Reserve life, sustaining capital, reclamation, minority claims and class transition are not fully reviewed.
LC.source_warning: Source equity is PHP thousands. Reported PHP0.12 BVPS approximately reconciles to both outstanding A and B common classes; dividing only by LC shares would overstate per-share book.

ATN.route_reason: Land, quarry and operating interests require attributable SOTP; pooled book is a separate screen.
ATN.intrinsic_blocker: Project cash flow, reserve rights, funding and class-transition details are not fully underwritten.
ATN.source_warning: ATN's financial year ends March 31, not December. PHP0.37 reported BVPS roughly reconciles to the 6.825bn pooled A+B outstanding shares, not the A line alone.

OPM.route_reason: Finite-life oil and gas interests require a risked asset SOTP and PHP conversion.
OPM.intrinsic_blocker: A reviewer-approved dated USD/PHP conversion and reserve/contract cash flows are unavailable; reported USD book cannot silently become PHP per share.
OPM.source_warning: PSE FY2025 and 1H2026 equity units are USD, while the public valuation contract is PHP. A and B share counts are reported separately; no exchange-rate proxy or policy-rate substitution is made.

FJP.route_reason: Subsidiary interests require attributable SOTP; equal-rights common book is only a screen.
FJP.intrinsic_blocker: Investment fair values, parent claims and the final exchange declassification record have not been reconciled.
FJP.source_warning: June 2026 company disclosure states A and B common shares have the same rights and privileges. The PHP5.71 printed BVPS does not reconcile to PHP2.090bn parent equity / 481.828m pooled shares; the screen uses the explicit reviewed bridge, not the printed BVPS.

DIZ.route_reason: Mineral rights require finite-life asset valuation; parent book is only a screen.
DIZ.intrinsic_blocker: Economic reserve estimates, license life, reclamation and financing are not underwritten.
DIZ.source_warning: FY2025 and 1H2026 revenue are zero. Parent book of PHP25.893m is not a proven-reserve value; the PSE PHP0.33 BVPS is rounded.

IMP.route_reason: Resource and investment rights require attributable SOTP; parent book is a finite screen.
IMP.intrinsic_blocker: The economic object, asset rights, cash recovery and financing have not been underwritten.
IMP.source_warning: Only 100m of 652.5m outstanding common shares appear listed; 1H2026 revenue is minimal and parent income negative. Printed BVPS roughly reconciles to all outstanding common shares.

FERRO.route_reason: Proposed property-for-share transactions require attributable and diluted SOTP; current book is only a screen.
FERRO.intrinsic_blocker: Property transactions, final share issuance, debt and post-transaction dilution are not completed or underwritten.
FERRO.source_warning: The current 341.824m common-share count is not a pro-forma post-transaction denominator. A disclosed property-for-share transaction could materially dilute this screen; no current price/upside is published.

ABG.route_reason: Prospective investments require attributable SOTP; existing total book is only a tentative screen.
ABG.intrinsic_blocker: Potential asset infusion, execution, financing and minority claims are not completed or appraised.
ABG.source_warning: PSE parent-equity field is blank and revenue absent; PHP246.343m total book / 300m shares is a Low-reliability proxy. The screen does not value proposed future business assets or explain current trading levels.
